title: Message actions
summary: The sheet that opens on a long press on a message: quick reactions on top, then the actions that apply to that message. Each action hands over to its own spec.

kind.description: One row of the sheet, in this order.

rowId.description: The message the sheet is open for. Missing while closed.

showsReactions.description: false for messages that take no reactions (message-reactions).

actions.description: Only the actions that apply to this message (see notes).

open.effect: Opens the sheet with a light haptic. Date, notice and handle-change rows have no sheet.

react.effect: message-reactions toggle, then closes the sheet.

moreReactions.effect: Closes the sheet and runs message-reactions openPicker.

choose.effect: Closes the sheet and runs: reply, message-reply startReply; edit, message-edit startEdit; copy, puts the text on the clipboard and shows bipe_app_copied; retry, chat-timeline retrySend; delete, message-delete askDelete; report, message-report open.

notes: reply: canReply and the message is sent. edit: canEdit. copy: text messages only. retry: own message with send state failed. delete: canDelete, or an own message not sent yet. report: messages of other people that are sent.
Undecryptable rows: report only, and the message-undecryptable help when its cause has one. Deleted rows have no sheet.
Not in this sheet (ADR 0141 and plan section 4): threads, pin, copy link to the message, forward, view source. Forward and media save come with #561.
The sheet shows the message on top, so the person sees what they act on. The haptic follows ADR 0134 (registries haptics, selection).
